baseline_v040_summary.honest_assessment: v0.4.0 converted sprites, bosses, and 19 N-SPC tracks, but core gameplay, movement, combat, overworld geometry, file select, house interiors, sound effects, and dialogue engine still remained overwhelmingly recognizable as A Link to the Past.

verified_v050_summary.honest_assessment: v0.5.0 transforms the live player experience with genuine 65c816 top-down Mario Jumping (L/R), Mario Stomp Combat (+bounce +coin +defeat puff), Super Mario Hammer, Fire Mario live CGRAM swap, Super Starman rainbow invincibility, native SPC700 Mario SFX, redesigned World 1 Yoshi's Island courtyard, Mario File Select & Start Menu (Fire/Ice Flowers, Green Warp Pipe, 100% Mario item names), Volcanic Bowser Throne, Crimson/Gold Toad House carpets, and fixed zero-overlap zero-hyphen French story. Honest remaining residue: Worlds 2-8 Map32 geography, Koopa guard blades, Title BG2 sword silhouette, custom Boss AI, and rideable Yoshi mount.
